what_worked: Clean, consistent visual template with readable typography and restrained color palette.
fix_next: Discard the generic template and build every slide from the actual 1,000-row dataset's fields and figures.
verdict: Entirely fabricated corporate template with zero connection to the assigned dataset.
factual_error_detail: Slide 3: $14.2M total revenue (actual $15.6M); +34% YoY growth, 92% retention, 4.8x LTV/CAC all fabricated. Slide 4: Enterprise SaaS/Mid-Market/SMB/Consumer segments don't exist in dataset. Slide 5: 45/30/15/10% geographic split fabricated (dataset has country field with 241 missing). Slide 6: quarterly trend Q1 2025–Q1 2026 fabricated. Slide 7: $12.5M target, $385 CAC, 168K MAU, NPS 68 all fabricated. Slide 11: cropped construction dashboard screenshot from rib-software.com is unrelated.

evidence.insight: Zero analytical findings reference any actual dataset dimension (category, provider, TLD, audience_type, anonymous status, on-sale multiples). All claims are generic consulting boilerplate.
evidence.narrative: Follows a cookie-cutter corporate report arc (overview → KPIs → segments → geography → trends → roadmap → Q&A) with no thesis, no analytical question, and no synthesis tied to the data.
evidence.framing: No mention of the 1,000-company dataset, payment providers, 30-day revenue window, missingness rates, or any scope/limitation. Audience labeled 'Executive Analytics Division' with no context.
evidence.accuracy: Every quantitative claim is invented: total revenue wrong, segments nonexistent, geographic percentages fabricated, quarterly time series fabricated, CAC/NPS/MAU figures have no dataset basis. Zero verifiable correct figures.
evidence.visual: Template is polished with consistent styling, but all charts are decorative fabrications. Slide 11 pastes a cropped, unrelated construction-software dashboard screenshot from rib-software.com.
evidence.ai_slop: Pervasive: 'robust momentum across all core verticals,' 'disciplined acquisition costs,' 'enhanced lifetime value,' 'executive agility in decision-making and resource deployment,' 'high-potential APAC regions.' Every text block is interchangeable filler.
